capabilities: add threaded comments and nested replies stored in Markdown
render discussion panels in Reading view and Live Preview
edit, reply to, and delete comments from a side panel
exchange feedback with AI agents via comment blocks in the note
mention an agent through the AI Overview integration to run tasks in a thread
disambiguation: Not a cloud commenting or real-time collaboration service; comments are stored in the note's own Markdown and exchanged by sharing or syncing the file.
extras: The AI Overview agent integration is optional, desktop-only, and requires a configured agent name tag; comment features work on mobile without it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep threaded comments and replies attached to note content, so feedback normally needs an external discussion service or lives outside the file.

relations.evidence: Supercharge agentic workflows in combination with AI Overview plugin
sends a SHA-256 hash of the email to Gravatar over HTTPS to retrieve the image

summary: Threaded discussion panels stored as <comment> blocks inside notes, for human review conversations and AI agent collaboration.
